title: Physical Layer Anomaly Detection via Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.18946v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical-layer spoofing attacks pose a critical threat to wireless localization systems by manipulating channel state information (CSI). Detecting such attacks becomes particularly challenging when the attacker and the legitimate node are spatially proximate, as their CSI characteristics become increasingly similar. To address this challenge in indoor scenarios, we propose an adaptive Gaussian mixture model (GMM)-based detection framework that learns legitimate CSI patterns and detects spatial inconsistency through statistical anomaly detection. Using a massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) experimental dataset with 64 uniform linear array (ULA) antenna and 5 mm spatial resolution, we evaluated our detector against CSI spoofing attacks with spatial displacements ranging from 50 mm to 450 mm. The adaptive GMM achieves 95-98% detection rate for displacements above 150 mm while maintaining 1% false alarm rate. We benchmark our app

translated_title: 基于自适应高斯混合模型的物理层异常检测
translated_abstract: 物理层欺骗攻击通过操纵信道状态信息（CSI）对无线定位系统构成严重威胁。当攻击者与合法节点在空间上十分接近时，由于两者的CSI特征变得日益相似，检测此类攻击变得尤为困难。为解决室内场景中的这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于自适应高斯混合模型（GMM）的检测框架，该框架通过学习合法CSI模式并利用统计异常检测来发现空间不一致性。我们使用具有64个均匀线性阵列（ULA）天线和5毫米空间分辨率的大规模多输入多输出（MIMO）实验数据集，针对空间位移范围为50毫米至450毫米的CSI欺骗攻击评估了所提出的检测器。自适应GMM在位移超过150毫米时实现了95-98%的检测率，同时保持1%的误报率。我们对该方法进行了基准测试
tldr: 提出基于自适应高斯混合模型的检测框架，通过学习合法CSI模式并检测统计异常，即使在攻击者与合法节点空间接近的情况下也能有效识别CSI欺骗攻击，在位移超过150毫米时实现95-98%的检测率且误报率仅为1%。
en_tdlr: An adaptive Gaussian mixture model-based framework detects physical-layer CSI spoofing attacks by learning legitimate CSI patterns, achieving 95-98% detection rate for spatial displacements above 150 mm while maintaining only 1% false alarm rate.
